newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle very slow at $64, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle very slow at $64, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow near midday on Tuesday, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher in a very limited test, USDA said.
Inquiry good, demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 1100 slaughter steers and 500 slaughter heifers early Tuesday. Week-to- date 10,800 head mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 64.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 1200 lbs 105.00 hot weights, deliverd. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 64.00. Confirmed - 1,600
